verdict.rationale: Loops is an email platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools falls outside its product role. The evidence shows only that Loops serves an official MCP server (mcp.loops.so) for external agents to connect to. That is the server role and earns no credit for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
